image_description: A close-up view of a wooden bookcase filled with books. The image shows three visible horizontal shelves made of reddish-brown wood. The top shelf contains hardcover books, some standing upright and others leaning. The middle shelf has a mix of paperback books, a small decorative object, and what appears to be a glass or plastic container. The bottom shelf is densely packed with colorful paperback books. A vertical wooden divider is visible on the left side. The background includes a plain white wall above the top shelf.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible or nonsensical. While some shapes resemble letters, many spines show blurred, melted, or invented characters typical of AI generation failing to render coherent typography. This is noticeable upon close inspection but does not destroy the overall object recognition.

The transparent/translucent object on the middle shelf has slightly inconsistent refraction and edge definition, appearing somewhat 'mushy' rather than having sharp glass-like edges. It blends slightly into the background.
The vertical wooden slats on the bottom left appear to merge or fade into the shadow/book spines without clear separation. The geometry is slightly ambiguous, suggesting minor structural blending.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or library stack.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture artifacts in the wood and books.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and coherence of the text on the book spines, which is a common failure point in AI-generated images.

Realism of wood texture and grain continuity

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the book spines. Even if the classifier identifies it as a bookcase, severe text gibberish is a significant artifact. Check if the books appear to be physically resting on the shelves or if they float/merge. Verify if the wood grain follows a logical pattern across the vertical and horizontal elements.
